# OpenGameArt — Hunting Rifle (FBX)

CC0 semi-auto hunting rifle by **Lucian Pavel** ([OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/content/hunting-rifle), 2016). ~2.1k tris, 2048 textures.

| Path | Notes |
|------|--------|
| `Model/HuntingRifle.fbx` | Weapon mesh |
| `Textures/` | Albedo, normal, specular |

Equipped on the player via `FirstPersonWeaponEquip` and `Assets/Prefabs/Weapons/HuntingRifleView.prefab`.
